about: The real-world corpus (plan section 10): published documents, workbooks and CSV files, and blank templates, from reputable publishers. The files aren't in the repository, because their licences vary; scripts/fetch-corpus.ps1 downloads them into FW_CORPUS, checks each hash and screens each file. Only hosts on the sources list are allowed, including after redirects.
layout: docx/<category>/<id>.docx, xlsx/<category>/<id>.xlsx (or .xltx), csv/<category>/<id>.csv (or .tsv); Office's PDFs in reference/<format>/<category>/<id>.<ext>.pdf (workbooks also .cells.json) with reference/manifest.json

categories.budgets: workbooks: household, student, project and grant budgets, cash-flow forecasts
categories.invoices: workbooks: invoices, quotes, order forms, price lists and expense claims
categories.schedules: workbooks: schedules, timesheets, rosters, calendars and attendance sheets
categories.grades: workbooks: grade lists, grade books and marking sheets
categories.calculators: workbooks: calculators and forms with formulas (loans, savings, tax, benefits, applications)
categories.statistics: workbooks and CSV files: statistics tables from statistics offices and ministries
categories.forms: form templates, with content controls or legacy form fields
categories.reports: reports and guidance with headings, numbered lists and a table of contents
categories.academic: papers and thesis templates: columns, footnotes, equations
categories.tables: invoices, budgets and other table-heavy documents
categories.manuals: manuals, guides, brochures and newsletters with pictures and text boxes
categories.legal: contracts, policies, procurement documents and legislation with multi-level numbering
categories.review: documents with comments or tracked changes
categories.features: small test files from LibreOffice's and Apache POI's test suites: charts, equations, right-to-left and East Asian text; for workbooks, number formats, conditional formats, charts and other features
